input_evidence.source: public GSE179848 RNA expression + GSE179847 published DNAm clocks, joined by published same-condition keys

method.input: Real measured per-condition fibroblast RNA marker scores paired with actual author-published DNA methylation clock ages.
method.OLS_model: within-series centered OLS of DNAm clock ~ passage; adjusted model also includes measured RNA fibroblast identity score
method.independent_check: Independent numpy.linalg.lstsq design with one-hot culture-series fixed effects reproduced both Horvath1 and GrimAge coefficients to <1e-10
method.sensitivity: Leave one independent donor out; 3^3=27 exhaustive with-replacement donor-cluster tuples; duplicate donors keep their replicate rows. All 27 were nonsingular.
method.statistics_limit: With only three biological donor clusters, empirical resampling quantiles are descriptive, not calibrated confidence intervals; no significance or causal independence established.

Horvath1.evidence_interpretation: Direction of RNA adjustment is NOT robust to leaving out donor HC2; with only three donors the effect cannot be claimed significant.

GrimAge_negative_control.evidence_interpretation: GrimAge shifts opposite to Horvath1 chronological aging slope in the same cultures; retain discordance as negative control, not selective narrative.
